scope: Isolated lever4 bulk picker, frozen 7dfa111c base; CPU selection only, not integrated controller admission or GPU evidence

leaves.name: auto-policy-scheduler-fields
leaves.replaces: Served EngineCore and vLLM FCFS Scheduler/Request/queue plus KV prefix manager
leaves.equivalence: Uses test_compose5_declines.Stage unchanged for policy fields, with real AutoArmPolicy._select/_plan, staged_chunk_plan, residue_hit, and PrefillAdmissionController._queue/_waiting_object. Requests carry pinned Request.arrival_time wall-clock floats (request.py:96); FCFS queues iterate in their existing order. Only cache lookup returns numeric frontiers, allocator free-block count and aligned splits are leaves; the junction-probe regression instead uses the exact pinned stock split from test_coverage_residue.SPLIT and asserts all three candidate Request objects, including the original head remain unchanged. All plan eligibility, rejected/cohort gates and ranking execute real runtime code. Lookup identity/order is recorded to catch duplicate work. The admission membership/permits seam is exercised, but main's nonhead admission adapter is intentionally not fabricated in this isolated branch.
leaves.cannot_prove: Full scheduler admission of a selected nonhead before main's adapter lands, live prefix lifetime/ownership, actual lookup latency, CUDA or memory behavior, throughput gain

leaves.name: wall-clock-and-existing-journal
leaves.replaces: Request age and existing driver's bounded _record journal
leaves.equivalence: time.time is fixed at an epoch-sized timestamp; the driver monotonic clock differs deliberately, so comparing the two clocks fails. The existing journal sink captures fields without deciding selection. Existing NativeSegmentDriver._record owns the bounded production journal; no new logging route is implemented. Tests assert identity, original position, rows, age classification, caps and cumulative extra lookup counts.
leaves.cannot_prove: Wall-clock jumps, actual journal retention/serialization cost or real logging overhead
